reference_trace: Read the locked event anchor and take the official window as 2019-12-01 through 2020-01-31, inclusive.
Inspect the Sentinel-2 dNBR file and verify that its post window 2019-12-01 through 2020-02-29 overlaps all 62 official event days.
Compute dNBR contrast from the Sentinel-2 stats: max minus mean = 0.903857, max over mean = 19.494223, and z-like contrast = 11.051036.
Reject the annual embedding change as a generic 2018-to-2019 cosine-change product and reject Open-Meteo as fire-weather context only.

criteria.name: Answer form
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON schema with answer type, claim, ruling, selected evidence, calculation check, rejected alternatives, source paths, and reference trace.
criteria.full_credit: All required fields are present and the answer is compact structured JSON.
criteria.partial_credit: Minor naming or formatting errors, but the evidence ruling is recoverable.
criteria.no_credit: Does not return the required structured arbitration answer.

criteria.name: Direct burn-change source
criteria.description: Selects the Sentinel-2 dNBR file as the direct burn-change source and reports its product role.
criteria.full_credit: Selects data/physical_hazard/physical_hazard_008_Sentinel-2_SR_Harmonized_dNBR.json with correct dNBR modality and pre/post windows.
criteria.partial_credit: Selects a remote-sensing file but misses product role or one window detail.
criteria.no_credit: Selects annual embedding, heat, report, or exposure files as the direct burn-change source.

criteria.name: Temporal alignment
criteria.description: Uses the official event window and computes overlap with the dNBR post window.
criteria.full_credit: Reports 62 event days, 62 overlapping dNBR post-window days, and 29 extra post-event days.
criteria.partial_credit: Gets the overlap direction right with a small inclusive-day counting error.
criteria.no_credit: Ignores event-window alignment or uses the wrong window.

criteria.name: dNBR calculations
criteria.description: Reports dNBR statistics and compact contrast calculations.
criteria.full_credit: Reports dNBR max, mean, min, stdDev and the 0.903857 max-minus-mean, 19.494223 max-over-mean, and 11.051036 z-like contrast values.
criteria.partial_credit: Most dNBR values are correct with minor rounding or one calculation error.
criteria.no_credit: Does not compute from the dNBR stats.

criteria.name: Embedding rejection
criteria.description: Rejects the annual satellite-embedding cosine-change file for role and temporal mismatch.
criteria.full_credit: Explains that the embedding file is a generic 2018-to-2019 cosine-change product, not dNBR or event-window burn severity, and reports the numeric source-swap consequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Rejects the embedding file but gives incomplete numeric or temporal support.
criteria.no_credit: Treats the embedding metric as interchangeable with dNBR.

criteria.name: Fire-weather context boundary
criteria.description: Keeps Open-Meteo heat and humidity evidence in a context-only role.
criteria.full_credit: Reports 42.2 C and 8 percent RH as context but not as burn-scar measurement.
criteria.partial_credit: Mentions heat context without the numeric anchor.
criteria.no_credit: Uses weather data as direct remote-sensing change evidence.

criteria.name: Scope and provenance
criteria.description: Uses package-relative paths only and avoids external evidence, hidden answers, broad disaster prose, and outside burn-severity thresholds.
criteria.full_credit: All provenance and scope constraints are followed.
criteria.partial_credit: Minor prose overreach without changing the answer.
criteria.no_credit: Uses web evidence, hidden answers, absolute answer paths, or external severity thresholds.

event.event_name: 2019-2020 Australian extreme heat during Black Summer

decision_rule.summary: Select the direct package-local burn-change product, compute its event-window alignment and dNBR contrast, and reject wrong-role source swaps.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating annual embedding cosine change as dNBR
using heat or humidity as burn-scar measurement
claiming exact burn area or impact not present in the package

supports: direct package-local dNBR evidence of localized burn-scar change
event-window/post-fire temporal overlap for the dNBR product
fire-weather context from local heat and low humidity
do_not_overclaim: burn-severity class based on external thresholds
annual embedding change as a burn-index substitute
heat values as direct burn-scar measurement
